name: bait-breakpoint-sync
description: Bait control, a frontend variant of the tuning-value pattern. The mobile and tablet breakpoints move from 599/600 to 767/768 px together, so the ranges stay adjacent as the comment says, and the comment names the design system version the values come from. The temptation: a device between 600 and 767 px now gets the mobile layout, or a landscape phone does. That is what the change is for. Nothing to report.
